titles.display: Spanish American wars of independence

raw.description: 1808–1833 series of armed conflicts in the Americas
raw.extract: The Spanish American wars of independence were a series of early 19th-century conflicts across the Spanish Empire that resulted in new independent nation states in the Americas. They began shortly after the outbreak of the Peninsular War, part of the broader Napoleonic Wars.
